title: Too Big, Too Small
learning_objectives: Use the words big, small and just right to compare
Retell the three tries in order
parent_prompts: Before reading: It is a sunny day and Sam needs a hat. Whose hats might be in the house?
After page 2: Why does Dad's hat fall over Sam's eyes?
After reading: Which hat was just right? How did Sam know?

pages.text: Sam needs a hat. The sun is hot.
pages.illustration_brief: Sam (blue shirt) at an open door, bright sun outside, hand shading eyes.
pages.audio_script: Sam needs a hat. The sun is hot.

pages.text: Dad's hat is too big. It slips down.
pages.illustration_brief: A big straw hat sits over Sam's eyes and nose; only the smile shows.
pages.audio_script: Dad's hat is too big. It slips down.

vocabulary.definition: Slides down or away by itself.
vocabulary.example: The wet soap slips out of my hand.

pages.text: The doll's hat is too small. It pops off.
pages.illustration_brief: A tiny pink hat balanced on top of Sam's head, tipping.
pages.audio_script: The doll's hat is too small. It pops off.

pages.illustration_brief: Sam kneels by an open box of clothes; a green cap corner is visible.

pages.text: A green cap! It is just right.
pages.illustration_brief: Sam wearing a green cap that fits, arms out, happy.
pages.audio_script: A green cap! It is just right.

pages.text: Now Sam can go out in the sun.
pages.illustration_brief: Sam outside under the sun in the green cap, walking on grass.
pages.audio_script: Now Sam can go out in the sun.

quiz.prompt: Why does Sam need a hat?
quiz.explanation: Page 1 says: The sun is hot.

quiz.prompt: Why does Dad's hat slip down?
quiz.explanation: Page 2 says: Dad's hat is too big. It slips down.

quiz.prompt: Which hat does Sam try last?
quiz.explanation: First Dad's hat (page 2), then the doll's hat (page 3), then the green cap (page 5).

quiz.prompt: Tell a grown-up about the three hats. What was wrong with the first two?
quiz.rubric: not yet: names one hat; with support: two hats and one problem with prompting; independent: three hats in order, says too big / too small / just right
quiz.explanation: Using the comparison words shows the child understood why each hat did or did not work.

activities.prompt: Put the hats in the order Sam tried them.

items.text: The doll's small hat pops off.
The green cap is just right.

activities.prompt: Match the word to what it means.

off_screen_prompt: Find one thing at home that is too big for you and one that is just right. Show someone.
